news.title: J&KBANK: Tier I Capital Raise And Governance Moves Will Support Upside
news.body: Analysts have raised Jammu and Kashmir Bank's fair value estimate from ₹161 to ₹198, citing updated assumptions that include a lower discount rate, a higher revenue growth outlook, a slightly softer profit margin profile, and a modestly higher future P/E multiple. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for May 5, 2026, at 11:00 Indian Standard Time to consider and approve the audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026 (Key Developments).

news.title: Price target increased by 28% to ₹198
news.body: Up from ₹155, the current price target is provided by 1 analyst. New target price is 42% above last closing price of ₹140. Stock is up 53% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹22.30 for next year compared to ₹21.42 last year.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹21.42 (vs ₹18.91 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹21.42 (up from ₹18.91 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹68.0b (down 2.1% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹23.6b (up 13% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 35% (up from 30% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 15% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 34% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: J&KBANK: Upcoming Tier I Capital Raise Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have revised their fair value estimate for Jammu and Kashmir Bank from ₹131 to ₹161, citing updated assumptions around the discount rate, profit margin, and forward P/E, which together support a higher price target framework. What's in the News The board has scheduled a meeting for January 20, 2026 to consider and approve the unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (company filing).

news.title: High number of new directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Government Nominee Director Shailendra Kumar was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2026. The company’s lack of board continuity is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: J&KBANK: Upcoming Capital Raise And Board Changes Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts now hold Jammu and Kashmir Bank's fair value estimate steady at ₹131. This reflects largely unchanged assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and forward P/E that together support a consistent price target outlook.

news.title: J&KBANK: Upcoming Results And Shareholder Meeting Will Guide Fairly Valued Outlook
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for Jammu and Kashmir Bank broadly steady at about ₹131, reflecting only marginal tweaks to assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E, rather than a change in their core view on the stock. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for January 20, 2026, to consider and approve the unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (company filing).

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 17%
news.body: After last week's 17% share price gain to ₹121, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 8x. Average forward P/E is 12x in the Banks industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 156% over the past three years.

This reflects only very small model tweaks to discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions rather than any shift in their fundamental view. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for January 20, 2026, to consider and approve unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: J&KBANK: Capital Plans And Stable Outlook Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have maintained their fair value estimate for Jammu and Kashmir Bank at ₹131.0, with only small adjustments to inputs such as the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E. This suggests their overall view on the stock's pricing has essentially remained unchanged.

news.title: J&KBANK: Upcoming Capital Plans Will Support Stronger Future Profitability
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for Jammu and Kashmir Bank steady at ₹131, highlighting small adjustments to discount rate, revenue growth and future P/E assumptions that largely offset one another in their valuation work. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled on Jan 20, 2026 to consider and approve the unaudited financial results, both consolidated and standalone, for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025 (company filing).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.28 (vs ₹4.80 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.28 (up from ₹4.80 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹18.0b (up 1.9% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹5.81b (up 10.0% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 32% (up from 30% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was primarily driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.6% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 2.5% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 19% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 22% per year.

news.title: J&KBANK: Planned Capital Raise Will Support Stronger Future Profitability
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Jammu and Kashmir Bank steady at ₹131. They cited only marginal tweaks to inputs like discount rate, long term revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions, rather than any shift in their core outlook.

news.title: J&KBANK: Capital Raise And Governance Moves Will Support Stronger Future Profitability
news.body: Analysts have modestly reaffirmed their outlook on Jammu and Kashmir Bank, keeping the fair value estimate effectively unchanged at ₹131.0 as they fine tune assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future price to earnings expectations. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for November 26, 2025, to consider raising additional Tier I and Tier II capital and to discuss other strategic matters (Key Developments).

news.title: J&KBANK: Upcoming Capital Plan Will Support Stable Profitability Outlook
news.body: Analysts have modestly reiterated their outlook on Jammu and Kashmir Bank, keeping the price target effectively unchanged at ₹131.00. Improved visibility on sustainable profitability and stable growth assumptions are seen as adequately reflected in current valuations.
